title: kotlin-coverage
description: Inputs of kotlin-coverage.yml (and the same inputs of kotlin-push-ci.yml) that reach a shell or a file path.

coverage-report-tasks.x-rule: a JSON array of one or more Gradle task names (letters, digits and _ . : -, not starting with '-'), e.g. ["koverXmlReportDebug"]

coverage-xml-path.x-rule: a relative path made of letters, digits and _ . / - (no '..', not starting with '/' or '-')

coverage-artifact-path.x-rule: a relative path made of letters, digits and _ . / - (no '..', not starting with '/' or '-')
